summary: Freightos Limited furnished a Form 6-K clarifying a typographical error in the proxy card (Exhibit 99.2) previously furnished November 4, 2026, for its 2026 Annual General Meeting scheduled December 16, 2026. The corrected record date is November 5, 2026, not November 9, 2026; the Company and transfer agent Continental Stock Transfer & Trust will tabulate proxies strictly on the November 5 record date, and the erroneous date has no legal significance. No shareholder action is required. This is a routine AGM mechanics correction, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendation on a transaction are stated.
